limits: Creator-authored journals are documentary evidence; not independently verified model responses.
No exact historical screenshot link is inferred from a text claim that screenshots were delivered.
Repeated dates are retained with source identity and are not assumed independent tests.
Origin narrative dated August 6 and formal milestone August 13 must remain distinct.
Publications preceded August 19 and the September baseline; no pristine pre-publication baseline claimed.
